candidates.title: Review Qt 6.11.2 Windows licensing inventory
criteria: Has the designated owner/legal reviewer approved the distribution terms and corresponding-source/build/relink obligations for this exact Qt 6.11.2 Windows inventory, including equivalent recipient access and retention?
candidates.content: BPR-0962 AC1 only. The owner-selected Qt upgrade changes the licensing/source inventory, so the accepted macOS licensing-v002 decision does not transfer. The unsigned native x64 Windows MSI retains six upstream source payloads and 58 Qt package records, including Microsoft redistribution notices. The ThirdParty folder linked below was copied from the exact administratively extracted MSI, not a separately authored approximation. QtBase is now 6.11.2, with source archive SHA-256 5b2e00eccaf5a4d8c14134ffa0ea8dfd0a35ae1ffc7f8d87fa4305a1ed23cf22; Qt's Apache Tika MIME XML attribution and its Apache-2.0 notice remain included. The separate version-bound corresponding-source asset model is unchanged: no source ZIP is embedded in the installed application; installed provenance, notices and source offer bind the exact release URL, digest and producer. Both binary and corresponding-source assets must reach every recipient at no extra charge through equivalent access, including offline/corporate copies and a fallback after private-repository access changes. Retention is indefinite until the accountable distribution owner documents that all applicable obligations ended, and never ends while matching binaries remain distributed. Build, Qt replacement/relinking and local verification instructions remain in SOURCE-OFFERS.txt. The prospective v0.1.3 source URL is unpublished. Review first-party distribution terms, mixed syntax-data licenses, upstream/toolchain terms and practical build/relink material for these exact bytes. Approval here does not approve vulnerabilities, security, signatures, native behavior or publication. Fresh Grype remains FAILED with 32 macOS / 30 Windows raw matches; no security-owner waiver exists. Producer 67f5e51407a883e4469cee6008048a001f7c13b3; Windows package SHA-256 0174d9ce46537601ffca81295eed3bcea31c7fc5666e35613b8e4d6810178ef6; SPDX b34099e6a7e957dc64916a649c2c036ce16ad26dcf0e1c9507b05a7fa979494b; separate source 11babc5ff5cc7865344835685223d4757bddfa433a4517d56fe9975f39436b3b. Package/source mechanics pass; legal/owner acceptance remains pending.
